name: cavemio-integrations
title: Integrations
description: Settings → Integrations, done properly: Connect waits on the provider's own window, then folds away as the account it connected opens in its place.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Each Connect button is named after its integration. Connecting, connected accounts, refusals and disconnects are announced in a status region; the drawn check is for the eye and the chip says "connected" to screen readers.
- Category tabs are a tablist that arrows move along; search filters by name and description.
- openOAuthWindow only accepts messages from your own origin, and gives the callback's message a moment to land before treating a closed window as cancelled.
- Reduced motion swaps Connect and the account in place, with no folds, blurs or glides.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: onConnect
props.description: – · Runs the provider's sign-in and returns the account it connected. Called inside the click. Throw to show Try again and the message.

props.name: onDisconnect
props.description: – · Disconnects after a confirm. Without it there is no Disconnect.

props.name: value
props.description: – · Controlled list: { id, name, description?, icon?, category?, account?, scopes? }.

props.name: settingsHref
props.description: – · A Settings link beside a connected integration's name.

props.name: title
props.description: "Integrations" · Heading and the list's accessible name.

props.name: openOAuthWindow
props.type: (url, { name?, width?, height?, type?, timeout? }) => Promise<data>
props.description: – · Exported helper: opens a centred window and resolves with what your callback posts ({ type: "oauth:done", … }) by postMessage or BroadcastChannel; rejects if the window closes first, is blocked or times out.

features.title: Connect without leaving
features.description: The provider’s own window opens and the button reads Connecting until it comes back.

features.title: It shows which account
features.description: The account’s avatar and name open in place of the button, and what the connection may do opens under the row.

features.title: Popups aren’t blocked
features.description: onConnect is called inside the click. The openOAuthWindow helper opens the window and waits for your callback page.

features.title: Refusals are explained
features.description: A closed or refused window shakes the button, says Try again and shows the reason under the description.

features.title: Categories and search
features.description: Tabs and search narrow the list, and the rows that stay glide into place.

features.title: Disconnect asks first
features.description: The plug stretches into a confirm. Once done, the account folds away and Connect returns.

states.title: connect
states.description: Connect turns to Connecting with a spinner the moment it's clicked; onConnect is called in the same click, so a window it opens isn't blocked.

states.title: connected
states.description: The button folds sideways (460ms) while the account chip opens from a 3px blur 120ms behind it; a check draws beside the name 380ms in. The scopes and the account's detail open under the row by height, and "3 connected" rolls.

states.title: refused
states.description: If onConnect throws, the button shakes and says Try again, and the reason lifts in over the description in red for 4.2s before both settle back.

states.title: filter
states.description: With more than one category, tabs appear and their highlight slides between them (380ms); search narrows by name and description. Rows that stay glide to their new places, the rest fold away.

states.title: disconnect
states.description: The plug stretches into a red Disconnect; a check draws, then the account folds back and Connect opens again.
